verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev's docs say retrying can be set globally in trigger.config or per task, and they show a task retrying 10 times with exponential backoff. A community comment independently confirms that uncaught errors trigger automatic retries. missing for 10: documentation of the individual backoff parameters (factor, min/max delay), evidence of step-level retries within a single task rather than whole-task retries

support.subject: As a developer, I can configure automatic retries with backoff for failed steps or activities

citations.quote: In your trigger.config file you can set the default retrying behavior for all tasks. On each task you can set the retrying behavior.
This task will retry 10 times with exponential backoff.
